label: Service business
description: Home, About, Services, Reviews and Contact for a business that sells its time and skill, such as a trade, clinic or consultancy.

site.name: Your business
site.description: A service business website with the pages customers look for first.

pages.name: Home
pages.title: Welcome
pages.description: The services you offer, who they are for and how to get in touch.

sections.title: What we do
sections.content:
Say in a sentence or two who you help and the problem you solve for them. Visitors decide in a few seconds whether this is the right place, so lead with their need rather than your history.

Then point them to the next step: see the services, or get in touch.

sections.title: Why people choose us
sections.content:
• Name the thing you do better than anyone nearby.
  • Say how quickly you reply and when you can start.
  • Mention a guarantee, a qualification or a years-in-business figure you can stand behind.

pages.name: About
pages.title: About us
pages.description: Who you are, how you work and what visitors can expect.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.content: Introduce the people behind the business: who you are, how you got started and what you care about. A real name and a real story build more trust than any slogan.

sections.title: How we work
sections.content: Describe what happens from the first conversation to the finished job, so a new customer knows what to expect and what you will need from them.

pages.name: Services
pages.title: Our services
pages.description: What you offer, what each service includes and how to book.

sections.title: What we offer
sections.content: List each service with a short description of what is included and who it suits. Keep each one to a few lines, and link to a page of its own when it needs more detail.

sections.title: Prices and booking
sections.content: Say how pricing works: a fixed price, a rate per hour or a quote after a visit. Tell people how to book and how long they will wait for a reply.

pages.name: Reviews
pages.title: What our customers say
pages.description: Reviews and results from people you have worked with.

sections.title: Reviews
sections.content: Add reviews from real customers here, with their permission and, where they agree, their name and town. Only publish words your customers have actually written.

sections.title: Share your experience
sections.content: Invite customers to send you a review after a job, and say how they can do it.

pages.name: Contact
pages.title: Contact us
pages.description: How to reach the business, opening hours and where to find it.

sections.title: Get in touch
sections.content: Give the best way to reach you first, whether that is a phone number, an email address or a form. Add your opening hours and the area you cover.

sections.title: Where to find us
sections.content: Add your address, parking and public transport details if customers visit you, or the areas you travel to if you go to them.
